# Packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggthemes)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(paletteer)
library(patchwork)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(tidyboot)


```

# Import Data
```{r}
#Data from pilot - N=8
data <-read.csv("../data/Object_State_Survey_Pilot_Testing.csv", fileEncoding = "UTF-8")

```

# Qualtrics data cleaning & reorganization
```{r}
# Remove second row (filled with Qualtrics misc)
data <- data[-c(2), ]

# Grab demographic columns
demos <- data %>%
  select(id,Age, Gender, Race, Hispanic, NES, EngAOA,NativeLang) %>%
  slice(-1)

# Move 'id' to the first column and delete demos
pre_clean_data <- data %>% relocate(id, .before = everything()) %>% select(-matches("Practice")) %>% select(-c(Age, Gender, Race, Hispanic, NES, NativeLang))


#Below will need to be changed for PG (adding null sub condition)
#Setting Up Rating Data
rating_data <- pre_clean_data %>%
  select(1, matches("_Before_|_After_|_Imply_")) %>%
  slice(-1) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -1,  
               names_to = "Condition",  
               values_to = "Score") %>%
  separate(Condition, 
           into = c("verb", "tense", "target_object", "question", "focus", "extra"), 
           sep = "_", 
           fill = "right") %>%
  select(-extra) %>%
  mutate(Score = na_if(Score, "")) %>%  
  mutate(Score = na_if(Score, " ")) %>% 
  drop_na(Score) %>%
  mutate(
    verb = recode(verb, "D" = "Drop", "C" = "Contact"),
    tense = recode(tense, "Pr" = "Present", "Pa" = "Past"),
    target_object = recode(target_object, "T" = "tomato", "B" = "Blueberry", "M" = "muffin"),
    focus = recode(focus, "NF" = "NotFocus", "F" = "Focus"),
    focus = recode(focus, "1" = "NA"),
    Score = as.numeric(Score),id= as.factor(id)) #make id factor

#Setting Up Ranking Data
ranking_data <- pre_clean_data %>%
  select(1, matches("_Rank_"))  

# Extract ranked objects from question text
new_names <-ranking_data %>%select(-1)%>%
  slice(1) %>%  # Select the first row
  unlist() %>%  # Convert to vector
  str_split(" - ", simplify = TRUE) %>%  # Split by " - "
  .[, 2]  # Get the word after the hyphen

# Replace numeric suffix in column names with extracted objects
colnames(ranking_data)[-1] <- str_replace(colnames(ranking_data)[-1], "\\d+$", new_names)

# Separate out conditions
ranking_data <- ranking_data %>% 
  slice(-1) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -1,  
               names_to = "Condition",  
               values_to = "Ranking") %>% 
  mutate(Ranking = na_if(Ranking, "")) %>%  
  mutate(Ranking = na_if(Ranking, " ")) %>% 
  drop_na(Ranking) %>%
  mutate(Condition_type = ifelse(str_starts(Condition, "C"), "C", "D"))  # Identify if drop or contact verb

# Separate out contact conditions (incl focus)
c_conditions <- ranking_data %>%
  filter(Condition_type == "C") %>%
  separate(Condition, 
           into = c("verb", "tense", "target_object", "question", "focus", "ranked_object"), 
           sep = "_", 
           fill = "right")

# Separate out drop conditions
d_conditions <- ranking_data %>%
  filter(Condition_type == "D") %>%
  separate(Condition, 
           into = c("verb", "tense", "target_object", "question", "ranked_object"), 
           sep = "_", 
           fill = "right") %>%
  mutate(focus = NA)  # Set focus to NA for 'D' conditions

# Combine the results
ranking_data <- bind_rows(c_conditions, d_conditions) %>%
  select(-Condition_type) %>% 
  mutate(
    verb = recode(verb, "D" = "Drop", "C" = "Contact"),
    tense = recode(tense, "Pr" = "Present", "Pa" = "Past"),
    target_object = recode(target_object, "T" = "tomato", "B" = "Blueberry", "M" = "muffin"),
    focus = recode(focus, "NF" = "NotFocus", "F" = "Focus")
  ) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Ranking) & str_trim(Ranking) != "") %>%
  mutate(ranked_object_recoded = recode(ranked_object,
                                "the muffin" = "target object",
                                "the tomato" = "target object",
                                "the blueberry" = "target object",
                                "the brick" = "falling object",
                                "the bowling ball" = "falling object"))  

```


## Rating Analyses
```{r}
#CBing condition of target_object not sig, dropping as factor in all analyses
#BEFORE the described event occurred, the object was...
#overall
before_analysis<-lmer(Score~verb*tense+(1|id),rating_data%>%filter(question=="Before"))
summary(before_analysis)
car::Anova(before_analysis)
#looking @ focus w/i "Came into contact" conditions
before_analysis_focus<-lmer(Score~tense*focus+(1|id),rating_data%>%filter(question=="Before",verb=="Contact"))
summary(before_analysis_focus)
car::Anova(before_analysis_focus)

#AFTER the described event occurred, the object was...
#overall
after_analysis<-lmer(Score~verb*tense+(1|id),rating_data%>%filter(question=="After"))
summary(after_analysis)
car::Anova(after_analysis)
#looking @ focus w/i "Came into contact" conditions
after_analysis_focus<-lmer(Score~tense*focus+(1|id),rating_data%>%filter(question=="After",verb=="Contact"))
summary(after_analysis_focus)
car::Anova(after_analysis_focus)

#Does the sentence imply that the object was smashed?
#overall
imply_analysis<-lmer(Score~verb*tense+(1|id),rating_data%>%filter(question=="Imply"))
summary(imply_analysis)
car::Anova(imply_analysis)
#looking @ focus w/i "Came into contact" conditions
imply_analysis_focus<-lmer(Score~tense*focus+(1|id),rating_data%>%filter(question=="Imply",verb=="Contact"))
summary(imply_analysis_focus)
car::Anova(imply_analysis_focus)
```

## Rating Plot
```{r}
#labels for figure
rating_data_plot <- rating_data %>% 
  mutate(
    question = recode(question, 
                      "Before" = "Before the described event occurred, the object was...", 
                      "After" = "After the described event occurred, the object was...", 
                      "Imply" = "Does the sentence imply that the object was smashed?"),
    question = factor(question, levels = c(
      "Does the sentence imply that the object was smashed?", 
      "After the described event occurred, the object was...", 
      "Before the described event occurred, the object was..."))
  )
#Drop
drop_rating_plot <- rating_data_plot %>%  
  filter(verb == "Drop") %>%
  group_by(question, tense) %>%
  tidyboot_mean(Score, nboot = 1000, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = question, y = empirical_stat, group = tense, fill = tense)) +
  geom_bar(stat = 'identity', position = "dodge") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), width = 0, position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
  ylim(0, 100) +  
  labs(y = 'Rating [Intact - Smashed]', x = "", title = "Verb - Drop") +
  theme_few() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),  # Rotate x-axis labels and adjust alignment
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14)
  )+coord_flip()

#Contact
contact_rating_plot <- rating_data_plot %>%  filter(verb == "Contact") %>%
  group_by(question,tense,focus) %>%
  tidyboot_mean(Score, nboot = 1000, na.rm = TRUE) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = question, y = empirical_stat, group = tense, fill = tense)) + facet_wrap(~focus)+
  geom_bar(stat = 'identity', position = "dodge") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), width = 0, position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
  ylim(0, 100) +  
  labs(y = 'Rating [Intact - Smashed]', x = "", title = "Verb - Contact") +
  theme_few() +theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),  
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14)
  )+coord_flip()

gridExtra::grid.arrange(drop_rating_plot,contact_rating_plot)

```

#Power analysis

```{r}
#using after_focus ratings to estimate finest grain comparison
library(simr)
set.seed(123)
small_effect <- 0.3 * sd(rating_data$Score) #cohens d = 0.3 for small effect
fixef(after_analysis_focus)["tensePresent:focusNotFocus"] = small_effect
# Extend the model
extended_model <- extend(after_analysis_focus, along = "id", n = 100)
power_curve <- powerCurve(extended_model, along = "id", fixed("tense:focus", "anova"), nsim = 1000)

# Plot the power curve
plot(power_curve)

#Aim for ~75 per lang
```

## Ranking Analysis
```{r}
library(ordinal)
#Drop verb conditions - Participants rank 3 objects 1-3 (you,target obj, dropped obj)
#ordinal logistic regression

ranking_data_drop<-ranking_data%>%filter(verb=="Drop")%>%
  mutate(
    Ranking = factor(Ranking, levels = c(1, 2, 3), ordered = TRUE),
    ranked_object_recoded = as.factor(ranked_object_recoded),
    tense = as.factor(tense))

# set reference categories for the model
contrasts(ranking_data_drop$tense) = contr.treatment(2, base = 2) #present as reference
contrasts(ranking_data_drop$ranked_object_recoded) = contr.treatment(3, base = 2) #target obj as reference

#too little variation among ids, so for now just using clm instead of clmm
model_drop <- clm(Ranking ~ ranked_object_recoded * tense, 
                   data = ranking_data_drop, 
                   link = "logit")
summary(model_drop)

#Contact verb conditions- Participants rank 2 objects 1-2 (target obj, falling obj)
#recode data
ranking_data_contact <- ranking_data %>%
  filter(verb == "Contact") %>%
  mutate(
    Ranking = as.factor(Ranking),
    ranked_object_recoded = as.factor(ranked_object_recoded),
    tense = as.factor(tense),
    target_object = as.factor(target_object),
    focus = as.factor(focus))
#model
# set reference categories for the model
contrasts(ranking_data_contact$tense) = contr.treatment(2, base = 2) #present as reference
contrasts(ranking_data_contact$focus) = contr.treatment(2, base = 2) #not focus as reference
contrasts(ranking_data_contact$ranked_object_recoded) = contr.treatment(2, base = 2) #only 2 levels, target obj as reference

model_contact <- clm(Ranking ~ ranked_object_recoded * tense * focus, 
                   data = ranking_data_contact, 
                   link = "logit")
summary(model_contact)


```

## Rank plot
```{r}

#logit plots
#bar plots since discrete/dependent rankings?
#drop
preds_drop <- data.frame(
  ranking_data_drop,  
  predict(model_drop, type = "prob")  # Get predicted probabilities
)
preds_drop_long <- preds_drop %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("fit"),  # Probabilities for each ranking level
               names_to = "Ranking_Level",
               values_to = "Probability")
ggplot(preds_drop_long, aes(x = as.numeric(Ranking), y = Probability, fill = ranked_object_recoded)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 2, 3), labels = c("1", "2", "3")) + 
  labs(title = "Predicted Probabilities by Ranked Object",
       x = "Ranking",
       y = "Probability",
       fill = "Ranked Object") +scale_fill_discrete(name = "Ranked Object")+
  theme_few()+scale_fill_paletteer_d("lisa::JackBush")


#contact
preds_contact <- data.frame(
  ranking_data_contact,  
  predict(model_contact, type = "prob")  # Get predicted probabilities
)
preds_contact_long <- preds_contact %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("fit"),  # Probabilities for each ranking level
               names_to = "Ranking_Level",
               values_to = "Probability")

ggplot(preds_contact_long, aes(x = as.factor(Ranking), y = Probability, fill = ranked_object_recoded)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge()) + 
  facet_wrap(~focus) +  
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("1", "2")) +  
  scale_fill_paletteer_d("lisa::JackBush", name = "Ranked Object") +  # Move 'name' inside this function
  labs(title = "Predicted Probabilities by Ranked Object",
       x = "Ranking",
       y = "Probability") +
  theme_few()



```
